doc.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013

title: Upcoming gigs and the missed chance with Duke Ellington
summary: Her back surgery, and regret at losing nerve at a Duke Ellington audition and with Hampton.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: What’s your next gig? You guys are going to Europe I think, or remind me, I may be confused.
Yes, they’re going to Europe. I’m not going because I’m recuperating from my back surgery. So it would be a stretch for me.
Well I loved the way you sang the gospel songs earlier today. Very powerful.
And I’m looking forward to your performance tonight. Do you have any, just quickly, any people you’ve been able to play with over the years and meet, that you’d like to say anything about?

Well the only thing I’d like to say is people I’ve met and could’ve worked for and didn’t take the opportunity, like working with Lionel Hampton’s band. I had an audition with Duke and got cold feet. They were recording. Someone he was working with said, “Come up to the recording.” I came but I left. I got cold feet. That’s somebody I really would love to have worked with. And I think I got overwhelmed by the thought of Duke Ellington you know.
